claim: Layer 2 at 640x256 scrolls only whole pixels; a half-pixel scroll needs two screens, one a half pixel on.

evidence.text: Layer 2 640x256 scrolls only whole pixels, so two screens (one half a pixel on) halve it.
evidence.quote: Layer 2 640x256 scrolls only whole pixels, so two screens (one half a pixel on) halve it.

evidence.text: N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite V08, by eye): 640x256 Layer 2 blocks lined up with 320-wide tilemap tiles, and after one X scroll step of both layers still no red at any edge: one step moved Layer 2 a whole 320 pixel (2 dots).
